name: storewright
description: Storewright — integrated store operations for mid-size grocers: online fulfillment, backroom, replenishment, staffing, and a simulation-driven operations twin.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/simulator/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/associate/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sim && npm run build:associate && npm run build:demo
scripts.build:site: npm run build:sim && npm run build:demo && node scripts/build-site.mjs
